verdict.rationale: The pack has no documentation of an execution or run-history log view, and no user-initiated retry of a failed run from its failing step. The only related item is the durable-execution note that interrupted runs resume from their last checkpoint. That is automatic infrastructure recovery from interruptions, an adjacent feature rather than an ops user inspecting logs and re-running a failed execution. The agent audit logs cover governance, not flow-run logs.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can inspect past execution logs and re-run a failed execution, resuming from the failing step
